answer: A saffron fermentation poll counts vessels where juniper ferments in a ferrous tank. During one fixed round, an independent inspector challenges all tanks simultaneously and signs each tank’s permanent ID, round and operator key. Voters sign ballots; validators check both signatures and atomically reject invalid or repeated tank IDs across aliases and reissues. An extra vote requires another tank available at that moment or its operator’s cooperation. This trusts inspection and ID integrity; rented tanks can concentrate votes.
